screens.title: PulseBoard Desktop Workspace Members
screens.note: Adapted, not pixel-identical: dropped fields with no backend support (squads/teams, 2FA status, per-member task counts, seat utilization, CSV export, bulk actions, pagination) and simplified roles to the real 3-tier model (owner/admin/member) instead of the mockup's Manager/Guest tiers. Same dark theme, sidebar shell, and card/table layout language.

screens.title: Workspaces list (create/switch)
screens.note: No Stitch design exists for this screen. Built by hand following the Pulse Precision theme and the new AppShell layout (src/components/app/AppShell.vue), since users need somewhere to land and create/pick a workspace before Workspace Members is reachable.

screens.title: Projects list (per workspace)
screens.note: No Stitch design exists for this screen (kanban-board-desktop and dashboard-desktop are Phase 4+ territory, not a plain project list). Built by hand following the same AppShell/Pulse Precision pattern as the workspaces list.

screens.title: Project members
screens.note: No Stitch design exists for this screen. Simpler sibling of the Workspace Members page: plain membership list (no roles), add restricted to existing workspace members via a select rather than free-form email invite.
